description: This PHP class defines a color parser for a debugging or introspection tool, capable of recognizing and converting various CSS color representations into a consistent format for display. It includes methods for parsing color strings, converting between color spaces, and handling named CSS3 colors.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Color
classes.description: A parser class for interpreting CSS color strings and converting them into standardized color formats with visualization support.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a variable as a color and generate an HTML representation with color details.

methods.name: _fits
methods.description: Determines if a given variable string matches a CSS color pattern or named color.

methods.name: _convert
methods.description: Converts a color string into an array with hexadecimal, RGB, HSL representations, and optional name.

methods.name: _HSLtoRGB
methods.description: Converts HSL color values to their RGB equivalents.

methods.name: _hue2rgb
methods.description: Helper function for HSL to RGB conversion, interpolates hue to RGB component.

methods.name: _RGBtoHSL
methods.description: Converts RGB color values to HSL representation.
